_why: Phase 6 implements the holdings_accounts domain's no_coverage=per_account_state_never_zero. The registry already names the four states; this patch records WHERE the per-account facts live (the account registry) and WHICH receipts the producer reads, so the gate can check them. Not applied here: config/data_source_authority.json and scripts/check_data_source_authority.py are owned by parallel agents.
_apply_with: json-merge into the named domain / providers; every key is additive. Nothing here changes a store, a writer, a cadence or a state name.

per_account_keys.service_unit: systemd --user unit the read sync depends on (optional)
per_account_keys.service_receipt: health-probe JSON for that unit, relative to project root (optional)
per_account_keys.manual_as_of: last manual statement / entry date (manual accounts)

state_evidence.sync_receipt: data/runtime/sync_receipts/<account_key>.json - written by the account's read sync at the end of each run ({ok, at, error})
state_evidence.service_receipt: per account registry service_receipt (moomoo: data/runtime/moomoo_opend_health.json, scripts/moomoo/opend_health.py every 5 min in session)
state_evidence.systemctl_fallback: `systemctl --user is-failed <service_unit>` - PRODUCER (scripts/portfolio_loader.py) ONLY, only when both receipts are absent or older than 2h; the repricer and every API handler pass allow_shell=False

holdings_accounts._gate_suggestion: check_data_source_authority.py: for the holdings_accounts domain, assert every account in the store's account_summaries has state in account_states (UNCLASSIFIED is a finding, ACCOUNT_UNCLASSIFIED), and that assets/portfolio_accounts.yaml declares sync_kind for every account that appears in the store (ACCOUNT_UNREGISTERED).
